scope: Three fresh native release processes. Timed: original real-template load/parse; complete template preparation; three filled slots and one blank; two complete active profiles; six already-prepared small RGBA PNG copies and full pixel-stream validation; one image graph batch; original per-slot drawing-order restoration; final DXF write, asset flush/fsync and atomic publication. Excludes process startup, input-manifest parsing/path resolution, raster/map rendering and fetch, network/BGT preparation, logos/contact restoration, GUI/GPU and output cleanup. Peak process working set includes startup/input parsing baselines and temporary documents. File-system cache is uncontrolled. This is a native prepared-input baseline, not a Python, raster-rendering or full-application comparison. Separate independent readback checks fields/order/geometry/ownership and PNG bytes/pixels.
